reviews.text: Always have a good experience with everyone at Lifetime Animal Care Center

They treated my fur baby like the KING he is 🐾💜🐾🌄🐾💜
AWESOME staff!! …
Thank you for the 5-star review Thais! We hope you and Peaches are having a great day!

We always have a positive experience with Lifetime Animal Care. They were able to get me in on short notice and saved me a ton of money by avoiding urgent care. Not to mention how good they are with our dogs!
Lifetime Animal Care is Wonderful! They took such great care of my old and fearful dog! Having just moved here, it is such a relief to have a vet that is both knowledgeable and caring!!!
We appreciate your 5-star rating, Susie! Thank you for choosing Lifetime Animal Care Center. If you have any concerns or feedback, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at (858) 274-1760.

The veterinarian and the Tec were so nice to my dog made her feel really comfortable. They did outstanding service. I will be definitely going back and referring my friends with animals to their veterinarian office.
Dr. Feigner and Dr. Patrusky have been beyond helpful. Highly recommend this vet!
Thank you for the 5-star review! We are glad to hear that you had a great visit.

"If mama's happy, everybody's happy."  My wife Dee could not stop singing your company's praises. Friendly, informative, professional staff,  spotless clean facility. She left with a big smile on her face. Thank you all for making that happen. Zoey, our Yorkie Terrier is a happy camper too. :-)
The whole staff was amazing as usual Dr Brooke was amazing she was very thorough and my dog Rusty loved her
Staff very knowledgeable and friendly. Dr Patrusky is amazing. Her care for our pets is very much appreciated.

Amazing staff-Amazing service. They treat your pets with a lot of love and you can tell they truly care for their well being. I am glad we found this place and will keep bringing Ace😊. Thanks for your great service and welcoming attitude…🙏

These folks are everything you want in a vet. They got me in fast, every person there from the moment you walk in and everyone else that you talk to is so wonderful and supportive and interested to learn everything they need to know about what your pet's problem is. So caring. Prices were great, they have terrific household pet family plans. Just a really nice find. Yeah, I can imagine taking your pet there for a lifetime.

Dr. Wilson, Nana and the receptionist were all very sympathetic to my many concerns with my new puppy, Bella. They had also taken care of Ziggy, my Rockstar who was killed by a hit and run driver. They truly love animals and understand the pain of losing a best friend.
Thank you for your feedback. We appreciate your support!
Always good so far😷

Probably hands down the best Vet clinic we have ever been to. The staff took great care of our darling Niya. We came in to get an International Health Certificate and to prepare our dog for moving to Peru. Dr. Patrusky was very knowledgeable and strategic in planning the process while holding the health and well being of our dear Niya to the highest standards. We are thankful for the sweet staff at Lifetime and will be sure to recommend Lifetime to friends and family. Thanks again!
Thank you for the 5 stars. We appreciate it!

I have to say, I love this vet clinic. The staff really care about the animals and they show them so much love. I have been seeing Dr. Feighner and he is amazing at what he does, he really seems to understand cats. He's been so great at taking care of my Kilala and Sakuro. Highly recommend them.

Everyone was wonderful,  front desk, Dr. and techs. They always give my Sandy patience and care. They are wonderful about answering all my questions. Paw plan is great for my Sandy's needs. A BIG THANKS to Dr.Patrusky.
Wow, I waited to long to establish care here.  What an incredible office, from the front desk to the Dr and supporting staff,exceptional!!!!!!
I’ve taken my last dog to them and now I have a new puppy. They are awesome-kind and helpful. I’m happy I stayed with them.
They’re very understanding and caring, I’ve taking my other pets to them. The Drs and Staff are great people they’re very understanding and caring.
Thank you for sharing your feedback!
We are pleased to receive your five-star rating and appreciate your trust in our veterinary care services.
Great service explained everything well great vibes all around
Friendly staff and my pets love seeing them.
a brief tech visit for blood and stool work, but easy and quick.

The clinic is sending reminders of due appointments through mail and phone call. It is easy to make an appointment. Staffs are friendly and accommodating. Doctor explains well the plan of treatments. A little bit pricey for procedures, labs and meds.

Thank you for giving me, my mother & Chihuahua a great visit. We’ve enjoy this establishment for years. We will always come here. Especially for there customer service, smell good facilities & professionalism with my fur baby. Thanks ladies.
We're privileged to have provided excellent care for your pet, Albert. Thank you for sharing your experience with Lifetime Animal Care Center.
Great experience at Lifetime Animal Care Center! Very caring and patient folks. I highly recommend.
Thank you for the 5 stars, Sandra!
My little dog had a number of health issues and Dr.P handled them all. The office is very organized re: covid-19 precautions, the visit went smoothly.
The staff and veterinarians are all so sweet and caring. My dog has been coming here since he was 6 weeks old. Lifetime treats us like family. I wouldn't take him anywhere else.
Thank you for the 5 stars Ricky! We appreciate it.

Took my furbaby in for a last minute nail trim--which she hates. Staff are always so sweet and patient with her, saying what a good girl she is, though I know she always fights when gettig her nails trimmed! I appreciate the extra time and care staff here take to keep her calm and minimize her anxiety. We have been coming to Lifetime animal care center from day 1 when I found my furbaby wandering the streets flea bitten, malnourished and PREGNANT 9 years ago. Would definitely give a thumbs up to the doctors and staff here.

Our previously affectionate, approachable, purring cat who would follow us anywhere now hides from us following a recent dental treatment.  His behavior has changed completely.  He looks at us fearfully now.  I have to wonder what happened at your clinic to bring about this drastic change in behavior.  I would also add that post care procedures and information regarding use of a collar were not shared before the surgery.  We were caught completely off guard and our home was unprepared for a cat wearing a collar.  Our sense is that you don’t work much with cats.  It’s telling in the options below that you don’t include feline care as a service.

Half of year, we spend in SD and Lifetime Animal Care Center is our kids (aka Dogs)'s Vet (actually our main Vet). We love new look! (waiting space got a new look!) and new staff; more Doctors. 6 months are long enough to miss things, but Lifetime Animal Care Center is always there for our kids! Busy office and sometime a little bit longer waiting time. But staff check us and let us know, we are not forgotten lol.
Everyone was helpful, professional, pleasant, kind and patient.
Friendly, caring staff with competent doctors.  Our dog is always scared going in but happy leaving.
You are always great and our kitty is living a long, long time and is very happy.  Couldn't ask for more.
MonAmi, my 8 pound puppy has received loving , patient and excellent care at Lifetime.  I also appreciate instant feedback.
Vets, techs and staff often changed through the years, but the care was always consistent. This doggie will be turning 14 this summer
Your positive experience at Lifetime Animal Care Center is greatly appreciated. Thank you for sharing your feedback with us.
They keep me updated on my dog's health.  The tech was very good with him and they answered my questions about Bravecto and offered an alternative.
Always caring and informative!!

Very good experience for our first time at this vet. We had a concern about our dog and they were able to get me in the same day. Our regular vet couldn’t get me in for days. I really liked the doctor, who sat and spoke with me for a while. I ended up joining their wellness plan.
Nice staff

They always make it easy for me to bring in
my large dog (with no other animals in the
lobby).

I’m so glad I found Lifetime Animal Care Center =) they made establishing care a smooth and easy process. They treated my kitten and I with so much kindness and professionalism. I highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a vet!
We have used for years.  Doctor's have changed over the years but the care and service has remained good for all our dogs.

We had our dog here for 8 years and were happy. Then a couple staff changes them the entire experience went to hell. All of a sudden every single issue needed multiple expenses lab tests. And usually an array of 3-5 tests. I once mentioned my dog had a lump on her side, and before they even looked at it, or felt it, she handed me a printout of 3 test I should get that came to $1300.
It was a harmless lipoma.
My dog once swallowed a corndog stick. They told me to get X-rays. $212 ( as I recall, could be wrong on exact cost) . Just to have them tell me a corn dog stick doesn't show up on X-rays.
The front desk staff are a nightmare. Always forgetting to renew prescriptions, having us come in twice for the same test, and sometimes confusing my two dogs.
I had to regrettably find a new vet because of the push to always get unnecessary test and the poor organization.

The care was good, I'll give them that. The vets do seem to care about the animals. Just drop all the greed.
Great caring
Always a nice place to bring my dogs.
Excellent service with friendly staff.
I have a reactive dog and they are VERY understanding, super nice and helpful, they provide me with a room to sit in while we wait for the doctor. They did amazing with my dog

My cats had to have their teeth cleaned. Curbside pickup and drop off was very good! They did an excellent job and my cats are happy again!!
Jettie has been so nice to me since I took her in for her nail trim. Go figure! She loves it there.
Another successful trip to the vet.
Just took my cat in and she acts all grateful when we get home !!!
Thank you for your feedback. Since this review appears to be empty, we invite you to share your experience with us by calling (858) 274-1760.
Friendly and on schedule !
Thank you for your generous feedback, Tiffany!

I trust Lifetime with all my pets. I’ve been taking my cats here for years and they’ve always managed to fit my babies in when I have a concern. I’m so grateful they’re around. Would definitely recommend them.
Thank you for taking the time to share your positive feedback. We appreciate your kind words and are glad to hear about your experience at Lifetime Animal Care Center.
Thank you immensely for your positive feedback!
Very user friendly
Very nice people. I also like how they follow up the day after an appt via text messages.
Great place! I took my Pom there and the vet answered all my questions
Very caring staff.
The Best Animal Care!
Lifetime Animal Care Center is great. The office and exam rooms are always clean. They care about our pets. Wish the Vets could stay longer and not rotate

Went to this facility for my puppy's first appointment and the experience was great. The staff were attentive and the waiting time was short. You can tell everyone was there because they cared. Dr. Patrusky took care of our puppy well. Definitely glad my wife and I found this place.

Everyone treated my French Bulldogs with great expertise. Everyone so nice considering this was our first visit and Dr Wilson was excellent and looking over our two girls
Thank you very much to all
Very dissatisfied with service and staff. I will never return or recommend. Thus clinic is outrageously overpriced.

We adopted a older dog at humane society. A checkup was provided but they didn't evaluate her! Lifetime ACC were the absolute opposite. Our girl was thoroughly examined by a wonderful vet who gave us insight into her health. Our vet and the staff are amazing! Knowledgeable  and very caring. This our permanent vet. I  highly recommend them.
Thank you for your 4 star rating, Paula. See you next time!
All the ladies in the front office are extremely nice. I’ve met 2 of the vets and like both of them.
Thank you for taking the time to share your positive feedback with us, Rocky. We greatly appreciate your support.
We are happy to hear about your positive experience at Lifetime Animal Care Center. Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback.

Amazing vet office with kind, professional, smart staff members. My current dog is a delicate little lady, but my previous large scary dog was a personality-plus handful, & everyone treated him with such empathy & gentleness.

Everyone was super friendly and accommodating even being new patients and getting us in the same day. It seemed like there is a lot of women working here which I loved since my girl is afraid of vets and men. The assistant Brooke and doctor gave her lots of treats and made her feel as comfortable as possible. This is not my normal clinic but I think we will be switching.
I was very pleased with Dr. P. and her assistant in their knowledge and ability to handle my very difficult tiny dog.  She is a challenge but they were patient and skilled and persevered.
Such a great place as a first timer, great service especially with my puppy she loves the people there!
Everyone was very helpful and very knowledgeable. I left with the care and meds I needed to keep my 7 yo dog healthy and happy. Thanks for all your help.

My family has brought our animals here for over a decade. All of the staff from the front desk to techs to vets clearly love animals and it shows in their care. Dr. Patrusky is so thorough and generous with her time to help me best care for my dog - she's an amazing doctor. Recently I spoke with Dr. Wilson about an upcoming procedure for my other dog, and she was very compassionate and helpful in addressing all of my concerns. Every vet tech here is exceptional.
Thank you immensely for your 5.0 rating, Robin! We're thrilled to hear about your positive experience at Lifetime Animal Care Center.
Excellent caring staff!

I’ve taken all three of my cats there over the years and have gotten exceptional service. I truly care about our pets and I can’t thank them enough.
We recently had one cat pass about 2 months back, she was 15 with kidney …
Thank you for your review, Melissa! We deeply cherish your feedback.
